name.zh: 勇者之塔 第24层 魔花仙子

location.zh: 精灵太空站 资源区 勇者之塔

reward_note: item_seer_beans = 赛尔豆 (the game currency); the catalog has no currency item yet, so the amount is carried as an item count.

capture.zh: 勇者之塔第24层：79级魔花仙子。通过本层获得：240赛尔豆

engine_notes: Remake progression (V53/V54): floors are climbed in order from the ten-floor starting points 1, 11, …, 61; a loss, retreat or cancelled load keeps the attempted floor, and the party may recover between floors. The 2010 tower allowed no healing between floors and sent a loser back to floor 1 (4399 2010-04-13: 如果挑战失败，要重新从一层开打); fleeing kept progress (只剩一只精灵时除非胜券在握，最好逃跑).
iv 15 is assumed for these wild-like floor monsters.
skills: sources name none (except where the tip implies one); the monster's highest pre-2013 learnset skills at or below its level are used.
HP 395 at Lv79: T客邦 2011-01-19 《挑戰勇者之塔－第21～30層》 floor table (TW server), https://www.techbang.com/posts/33132.
source_note: 4399 勇者之塔1-60层攻略 (2010-04-13): floor, monster, level (J) and reward per floor. HP: T客邦 2011-01-19 第21～30層 floor table (TW server).
